text:
maya: heads-up: got a noisy alert from prod-pager that resulted in 3 duplicate pages from inc-bot within 30s. channel #incidents-auto was auto-muted by the suppressor rule during the flood so oncall didn't see the later pages :grimacing:
inc-bot: [automated] dispatched 3 pages for alert_id=ALRT-9234 -> routed to oncall-team, phone-hook, sms-fanout
oliver: omg, seeing it now. are duplicates from retry loop or webhook fanout?
sam: logs show repeated 500 from /pagerhook endpoint then retry was triggered by our worker. snippet:
```
ERROR: webhook dispatch failed status=500 id=ALRT-9234 attempt=2
queue.retry(backoff=5s)
```
emma: suppressor muted the channel per rule `flood_threshold=5/1m`, but that was a global mute. oncall routing uses channel->pager mapping; when channel muted the bot's follow-up messages didn't escalate
ops-lead: tl;dr: duplicate dispatch + global channel mute = missed escalation. Customer affected? any confirmed pages to customer?
oncall-ny: I got 1 SMS at 15:34 but phone call didn't come through. customer reported delayed notification via support ticket (#12488)
maya: customer impact: small subset of accounts (eu-prod) saw delayed notifications ~3-7m. Pagerlog shows late ACKs. attaching plan: rollback suppressor to channel-local + add dedupe window
sam: proposed hotfix:
```
- change retry policy: max_attempts=3
- idempotency-key: use alert_uuid
- suppressor scope: channel_local=true
```
oliver: also recommend adding a short dedupe TTL in inc-bot: dedupe_ms=60000
ops-lead: Maya/Emma/Sam, can you own a live patch? I'll coordinate with oncall and customer comms. 
maya: on it, patching suppressor now (rolling restart of notifier-svc)
inc-bot: [automated] suppressor config updated by maya@ops (version v1.2.7) - rolling restart started
oncall-ny: confirm: call path retried and triggered after patch, call went out at 15:42
emma: filing postmortem draft and will include timeline + runbook changes. will ping legal for customer comms approval.
ops-lead: ok. thanks. follow-up: add a canary test to inject duplicate webhooks into staging to validate suppressor behavior. assign to sam.
sam: assigned. will deliver test and monitor metric: page_dup_rate
maya: thanks everyone. closing live thread once postmortem doc is up :white_check_mark:
